findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection in Image Plugins
 * @description Detects command injection in EpsImagePlugin and GifImagePlugin
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-plugins
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["check_call", "call", "Popen", "run"]).getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
    |
      sink = call.getArg(_)
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;

from DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flow(source, sink)
  and (
    sink.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "EpsImagePlugin.py" or
    sink.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "GifImagePlugin.py"
  )
select sink, "Potential command injection from " + source.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Command injection in EpsImagePlugin and GifImagePlugin via subprocess calls with tainted arguments.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Check for shell=True or os.system
 * @description Checks for subprocess calls with shell=True or usage of os.system/os.popen
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/shell-true-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() and
    call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
  ) or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess with shell=True or os.system/popen"
findings.hypothesis: Check if subprocess calls use shell=True or if os.system/popen is used, which increases the risk of command injection.
